cards.title: Error Spike in Hour 14
cards.detail: At hour 14, errors surged to 1,460 (15.8% of 9,225 requests) compared to 31 errors (0.35%) in other hours. This represents 67% of all errors in the week.

cards.title: caller-07 Cost Anomaly
cards.detail: caller-07 spent $174.12 on 1,180 requests, a cost per request of $0.148, which is 9 times the overall average of $0.016. Its cache hit rate is only 4%.

cards.title: Model epsilon 100% Error Rate
cards.detail: Model epsilon processed 40 requests, all of which returned errors, with zero spend. This suggests the model may be misconfigured or unavailable.

cards.title: caller-01 Dominates Usage
cards.detail: caller-01 made 105,832 requests (51.6% of all requests) and accounted for $1,643.86 (49% of spend). Its errors were 952 (44% of total errors).

cards.title: Model-alpha Latency Highest
cards.detail: Model-alpha has the highest p95 latency at 2,454 ms, while other models range from 1,310 ms to 2,229 ms. This could impact user experience for heavy users.

cards.title: Low Cache Hit Rates in Many Callers
cards.detail: Nine callers have cache hit rates below 10%, with the lowest at 3.7% (caller-21) and 4% (caller-07). This drives higher costs and slower responses.
